description.en: Original Hurdia-inspired marine radiodont: large projecting triangular central shield with paired lateral paddle elements, short soft trunk and triangular lateral flaps, ventral curved rake appendages, short-stalked eyes at rear shield notches and two rounded tail lobes. Microteeth and soft-tissue counts simplified, no predation or movement mechanism claim.
description.zh: 原创Hurdia启发海生奇虾类：前伸三角中央大甲与成对侧桨甲、短软躯及三角侧叶、腹侧弯耙肢、后甲角短柄眼和两圆尾叶。微耙齿和软组织数量省简，不承诺捕食或运动机制。
